theme_and_archetype.rationale: Matches the 'Тёмная Шиншилла' and 'Изумрудный' choices from the prompt. Focuses on cinematic depth, tactile surfaces, and premium luxury hospitality. 'Time of Day' will shift temperature but keep a sophisticated baseline.

typography.rationale: Cormorant Garamond brings a high-end, tactile, architectural elegance with excellent Cyrillic support, breaking the 'Inter' genericism. Manrope acts as a sterile, precise geometric counterweight for high legibility.

sizes.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-light

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid for Marketing sections, 1px brass borders for architectural framing.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 with overlapping spans (col-span-8, col-span-4).
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous padding: p-8 for cards, p-24 to p-32 for section vertical rhythm.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid rgba(197, 160, 89, 0.3) for elegant architectural definition. No heavy shadows, rely on inner glows and sharp edges.

header.behavior: Sticky z-50 with fluid logo resize on scroll.

hero.layout: Full height (min-h-screen) with multi-layered SVG silhouette of St. Petersburg at the bottom.
hero.effects: Parallax depth, dynamic color overlay driven by 'time of day' (warm day vs cool twilight), live weather overlay (canvas/particles for rain or fog).
hero.booking_form: Floating architectural glass card overlapping the hero section at the bottom center.

bento_features.style: Neumorphic/Glass hybrid cards. 1px brass border. Hover reveals macro tactile textures.

room_cards.style: Tall portrait ratio (aspect-[3/4]). Image scale-up on hover, bottom gradient overlay with typography revealing on hover. Emerald heart icon for 'favorites' with spring animation.

ai_concierge.style: Floating deep emerald pill/icon at bottom right. Opens a sleek crystal glass chat window with tactile UI.

motion_and_interactions.reveals: Staggered fade-up with Framer Motion, subtle scale (0.95 -> 1) on scroll enter.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Magnetic buttons for CTA, SVG path tracing for the St. Petersburg skyline on load.

media_and_assets.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Thin or Light weight) for elegant, architectural line icons.

images.description: Macro shot of deep emerald fabric texture for bento backgrounds or hover states.
Chinchilla grey marble wall with thin brass metal inlays, use as background pattern.
Sleek modern minimalist bed in a luxury hotel.
River running through city next to tall buildings.

development_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-booking-btn')
development_instructions.implementation_notes: Use standard Shadcn components for forms/inputs, but heavily customize them with border-[#C5A059]/30 and bg-transparent for the 'architectural' look. Avoid Shadcn cards for main bento; use raw HTML+Tailwind for asymmetrical overlapping.
